title: The Wedding Feast and Confrontations

questions.question: In the Parable of the Wedding Feast, what did the king do when those invited would not come and made light of it?
options: He was angry, sent his troops, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city
He canceled the feast and mourned for a week
He forced them to come at sword point
He ate the feast alone with his son
questions.correctAnswer: He was angry, sent his troops, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:7 (ESV): "The king was angry, and he sent his troops and destroyed those murderers and burned their city."

questions.question: After the initial guests refused, who did the king invite to the wedding hall?
options: He told his servants to go to the main roads and invite as many as they found, both bad and good
questions.correctAnswer: He told his servants to go to the main roads and invite as many as they found, both bad and good
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:9-10 (ESV): "Go therefore to the main roads and invite to the wedding feast as many as you find... so they gathered all whom they found, both bad and good."

questions.question: When the king came to look at the guests, he saw a man who did not have what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:11 (ESV): "But when the king came in to look at the guests, he saw there a man who had no wedding garment."

questions.question: What was the punishment for the man without a wedding garment?
options: "Bind him hand and foot and cast him into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
"Whip him and throw him in the street."
"Send him to the kitchens to work."
"Deny him food and drink for the rest of his days."
questions.correctAnswer: "Bind him hand and foot and cast him into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:13 (ESV): "Then the king said to the attendants, 'Bind him hand and foot and cast him into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'"

questions.question: Complete the conclusion to the Parable of the Wedding Feast: "For many are called, but..."
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:14 (ESV): "For many are called, but few are chosen."

questions.question: When the Pharisees sent their disciples along with the Herodians to trap Jesus in His words, what did they ask Him?
options: "Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"
"Should we stone a woman caught in adultery?"
"Should the Sabbath be holy to all Nations?"
"Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:17 (ESV): "Tell us, then, what you think. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

questions.question: Knowing their malice, Jesus asked them to bring Him the coin for the tax. Whose likeness and inscription was on it?
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:20-21 (ESV): "And Jesus said to them, 'Whose likeness and inscription is this?' They said, 'Caesar's.'"

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the trap about paying taxes?
options: "Therefore render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."
"Pay Caesar nothing, for the Lord is your King."
questions.correctAnswer: "Therefore render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:21 (ESV): "Then he said to them, 'Therefore render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's.'"

questions.question: The Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, asked Jesus a question about seven brothers who died after being married to the same woman. Their question was, "In the resurrection, therefore, of the seven, whose wife will she be?" What was Jesus' answer about the state of marriage in the resurrection?
options: "For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven."
"She will be married to the first brother."
"The woman chooses who she wishes to be wed."
"She will be married to all seven."
questions.correctAnswer: "For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven."
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:30 (ESV): "For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven."

questions.question: Jesus rebuked the Sadducees saying, "He is not God of the dead, but of the..." what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:32 (ESV): "I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? He is not God of the dead, but of the living."

questions.question: When a Pharisee lawyer asked Jesus, "Which is the great commandment in the Law?", how did Jesus respond with the first and great commandment?
options: "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind."
"You shall have no other gods before me."
"You shall not covet your neighbor's house."
questions.correctAnswer: "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind."
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:37 (ESV): "And he said to him, 'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.'"

questions.question: What is the "second" commandment that is like the first?
options: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
"Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy."
"Do not bear false witness against your neighbor."
"Love your enemies and pray for them."
questions.correctAnswer: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:39 (ESV): "And a second is like it: You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

questions.question: According to Jesus, what depend on these two commandments?
options: All the Law and the Prophets depend on these two commandments
Your eternal salvation depends entirely on them
The survival of the nation of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: All the Law and the Prophets depend on these two commandments
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:40 (ESV): "On these two commandments depend all the Law and the Prophets."

questions.question: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them, "What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?" What did they answer?
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:42 (ESV): "'What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?' They said to him, 'The son of David.'"

questions.question: Jesus counters their answer by asking, if the Christ is David's son, how is it then that David, in the Spirit, calls him what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:43-45 (ESV): "He said to them, 'How is it then that David, in the Spirit, calls him Lord...' 'If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?'"

key_verse_text: And he said to him, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the great and first commandment. And a second is like it: You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
